name: Group Show: '(Zieh mir den) Zahn der Zeit'
description: BODE presents '(Zieh mir den) Zahn der Zeit' (Pull the Tooth of Time), a group exhibition opening Thursday, March 6. The show brings together works that grapple with temporality, decay, and the weight of history. BODE is located at Karl-Marx-Allee 82 and is open Wednesday–Friday, 11am–4pm. This is a compelling exploration of how artists metabolize time itself.
